en.bdb: The difference between the spiritual and the temporal kings

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੁਨੀਆਵਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਹੋਇ ਦੇਇ ਮਰੈ ਪੁਤੈ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੀ।
verses.translit_en: dhuneeaavaa paatisaahu hoi dhei marai putai paatisaahee|

en.bdb: The temporal king dies after handing over the kingdom to his son .

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੋਹੀ ਫੇਰੈ ਆਪਣੀ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਬੰਦੇ ਸਭ ਸਿਪਾਹੀ।
verses.translit_en: dhohee ferai aapanee hukamee ba(n)dhe sabh sipaahee|

en.bdb: He establishes his sway over the world and all his soldiers obey him.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੁਤਬਾ ਜਾਇ ਪੜਾਇਦਾ ਕਾਜੀ ਮੁਲਾਂ ਕਰੈ ਉਗਾਹੀ।
verses.translit_en: kutabaa jai paRaidhaa kaajee mulaa(n) karai ugaahee|

en.bdb: In the mosque he orders prayers to be said in his name and gaffs and the mullahs (spritual persons in the religious orders of Islam) testify for him.

verses.gurmukhi: ਟਕਸਾਲੈ ਸਿਕਾ ਪਵੈ ਹੁਕਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੁਪੇਦੀ ਸਿਆਹੀ।
verses.translit_en: Takasaalai sikaa pavai hukamai vich supedhee siaahee|

en.bdb: From the mint comes out the coin in his name and every right and wrong is committed at his order.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਲੁ ਮੁਲਕੁ ਅਪਣਾਇਦਾ ਤਖਤ ਬਖਤ ਚੜੑਹਿ ਬੇਪਰਵਾਹੀ।
verses.translit_en: maal mulak apanaidhaa takhat bakhat chaR(h)h beparavaahee|

en.bdb: He controlles the property and wealth of the country and sits on the throne caring for none. (However) The tradition of the House of the Guru is that the high way shown by earlier Gurus is followed .

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾਣੈ ਘਰਿ ਚਾਲ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਾਡੀ ਰਾਹੁ ਨਿਬਾਹੀ।
verses.translit_en: baabaanai ghar chaal hai gurmukh gaaddee raahu nibaahee|

en.bdb: In this tradition only the one primal Lord is applauded; the mint (holy congregation) is one here;

verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਦੋਹੀ ਟਕਸਾਲ ਇਕ ਕੁਤਬਾ ਤਖਤੁ ਸਚਾ ਦਰਗਾਹੀ।
verses.translit_en: eik dhohee Takasaal ik kutabaa takhat sachaa dharagaahee|

en.bdb: The sermon (of Min) is one and the true throne (the spiritual seat) is also one here.
Justice of the Lord is such that this fruit of pleasure is given to the gurmukhs by the supreme Lord.
